start: Help and feedback sheet open, microphone allowed, online

steps.action: Tap the round Speak button
user_sees: The button turns red with a square
'Stop · 0:01 / 2:00' with a moving level bar
'Listening. Speak in Hindi or English, then tap Stop.'
must_not: Recording before Speak is tapped
The clock stuck at 0:00

steps.action: Speak for a few seconds, then tap the button again (Stop)
user_sees: 'Turning your voice into text…' with a spinner
The box locked while it writes
must_not: The recording kept on the phone after the text comes
The text sent to the team before Send

steps.action: Read the words that landed in the box, fix one, tap Send
user_sees: 'Check the text. Fix anything, then tap Send.' in green
The heard words added under what was already typed
'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: What was typed before replaced by the heard words
The message sent as typed when it was spoken

start: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback page

steps.action: Tap Speak, talk, tap Stop
user_sees: The same 'Turning your voice into text…' then the words in the box
must_not: A different recorder or words from the floating sheet's box
The phone's own speech-to-text used

steps.action: Leave the page while still recording
user_sees: Back on Settings; no recording keeps going
must_not: The microphone still on after leaving
The clip left on the phone

start: Help and feedback sheet open, microphone never allowed

steps.action: Tap Speak and refuse the microphone
user_sees: 'MettleUp needs the microphone to hear you. Allow it in your phone Settings, or type instead.'
'Open Settings' when the phone will not ask again
must_not: A crash
A prompt again on every tap after 'Don't ask again'
A recording started

steps.action: Allow it, tap Speak and tap Stop within a second
user_sees: 'That was too short. Tap Speak and talk for a few seconds.'
must_not: A clip sent to the server
An empty message in the box

steps.action: Speak with the internet off, then tap Stop
user_sees: 'Couldn't reach us. Check your internet and try again, or type.'
must_not: The typed text lost
The screen stuck on 'Turning your voice into text…'

start: Recording in progress in the sheet

steps.action: Tap the X (Cancel) beside the red button
user_sees: Back to 'Speak' with nothing added to the box
must_not: The cancelled clip turned into text
The clip sent to the server

steps.action: Tap Speak again and let it run to 2:00
user_sees: At 2:00 it stops by itself and turns what was heard into text
must_not: 'That was too short' for a full 2-minute note
The screen stuck on recording

steps.action: Read the line under the box before tapping Speak
user_sees: 'When you tap Stop, your recording goes through our server to an AI service in the USA that turns speech into text. Only the recording is sent. Neither we nor that service keep it. The text reaches us only if you tap Send.'
must_not: The microphone used at any other time
The recording kept by us or the service
The text reaching the team without Send
